servinfo.title: Front Strut Assembly Disassembly and Reassembly

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Front Strut Assembly Removal and Installation

attention1.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions when compressing the coil spring can result in severe personal injury.

item.ptxt: Attach the spring compressors to the positions that allow compressing the spring evenly.
Do not use an impact wrench when compressing the coil spring.
When using commercially available spring compressors, follow the manufacturer’s instructions described in the manual attached to the spring compressors.

s1.ptxt: Attach special tool to coil spring as shown. Screw in special tool bolts (1) alternately until coil spring tension is released from strut. Rotate strut to check that it is free of coil spring tension. Record total length of compressed coil spring when it is compressed.
While keeping coil spring compressed using special tool, remove strut support lower nut (1) using hexagon wrench (2) as shown in figure.

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Coil Spring, Strut Bearing and Strut Support Check

s1.ptxt: Compress coil spring using special tool (spring compressor) evenly until total length “a” becomes the same length as recorded in disassembly.
Install coil spring lower seat (2) to front strut by fitting its protrusions (1) into holes (3) in front strut.
Install compressed coil spring to front strut by fitting coil spring end (1) with protrusion of coil spring lower seat (2) as shown in figure.

attention3.ptxt: Coil spring end should not ride on step in coil spring lower seat.

s1.ptxt: Install bump stopper (1) directing slit side (2) upward.
Set strut dust cover (1) over four claws (2) of damper cap (3).
Pull strut rod as far up as possible and use care not to allow it to retract into strut.
Install strut bearing, strut bearing plate, strut support and strut support lower nut in this sequence.
Then tighten strut support lower nut (1) to specified torque while holding stud using hexagon wrench.
Remove special tool (spring compressor) from coil spring. Then check that coil spring end does not ride on protrusion of spring lower seat.
